title: Bali at a Glance | Group Tour Package
highlights: Set yourself on an unforgettable journey from Ubud to Kuta, enjoying a visit to the best attractions and amazing experiences that Bali has to offer.
Immerse yourself in the beauty of Uluwatu Temple's views and the famous Kecak Dance, believed to possess a connection to the Balinese ritual Sanghyang.
Take a moment to admire the stunning beauty of the Jatiluwih Rice Terraces, a UNESCO World Heritage site that showcases Bali's agricultural heritage.
Enjoy a visit to Tukad Cepung Waterfall, where sunlight creates beautiful rainbows in the water, making it a magical and peaceful place to visit.
inclusions: 6 nights stay in Bali with breakfast

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered as a valid address proof.
Visa assistance will be provided however charges are not included.
Travel insurance is recommended and charges are not included.
Meals not mentioned are not included in the package.
Personal expenses and mandatory hotel taxes (if any) will have to be paid by you at the destination.
Please depart on suggested timings to avoid any inconvenience.
Please do not litter and keep the environment clean.
Rates may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travellers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon your arrival at the Bali Airport, get transferred to the hotel for check-in. The entire day is yours, you can either relax for the day or explore Bali at your own pace by visiting some of its famous places, like wonderful Goa Gajah Gianyar, stunning Sekumpul Waterfall, and the beautiful Garuda Wishnu, among other famous attractions. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Visit to Kintamani Village & Tukad Cepung Waterfalls
days.desc: Prepare yourself for an amazing experience today as you get transferred for the stunning tour of Northeast Bali. Your first stop will be at the traditional markets of Ubud, where you can find beautifully carved souvenirs. Next, enjoy a visit to the Tukad Cepung Waterfall, one of Bali's most captivating attractions. After a day filled with breathtaking sights, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tanah Lot & Uluwatu Temple Tour with Kecak Fire Dance
days.desc: Prepare yourself for an amazing experience as you explore two beautiful temples in Bali. Get transferred from the hotel to the stunning Uluwatu Temple. Admire the beauty of this stunning shrine and enjoy the dramatic Kecak fire dance as you watch the crashing waves of the Indian Ocean. Continue the journey and reach Tanah Lot Temple, an iconic Balinese landmark that offers breathtaking views, especially during sunset. After an amazing day, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: North Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Start your day with a journey to North Bali. Get transferred from the hotel to the Bedugul Mountain resort to admire the views of Lake Beratan and Ulun Danu Temple. Continue the journey and make a stop at Mengwi to see Taman Ayun Temple, an amazing example of Balinese architecture. Next, head towards the famous Jatiluwih Rice Terraces, which showcase Bali's irrigation system and provide amazing views of green rice fields. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Day in Ubud
days.desc: Take the day to explore the city on your own by visiting the amazing town of Ubud, Bali. You can start your day by exploring Ubud Monkey Forest and Ubud Celuk Village. In the afternoon, you can spend some time at Komaneka Fine Art Gallery, Tirta Empul Temple, and Setia Darma Masks & Puppets House. As the evening approaches, visit the serene Pura Taman Saraswati Temple and Holy Spring Water Temple. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Day in Kuta
days.desc: Make the most of your time in Bali and visit the stunning town of Kuta at your own pace. You can spend your morning watching a sunrise at the beautiful Kedongana Beach or spend time in peace at Pura Petitenget Temple. Spend the afternoon at Kuta Beach Sea Turtle Conversation or explore Kuta Square. Later, in the evening, you can watch traditional shows at Kuta Theater or explore the night market. Afterward, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to the Bali Airport for your flight back home. Do not forget to pack your bags with amazing souvenirs and memories of this trip!
